question: How do I start a project?
answer:
Run `npm create vibelang@latest my-app`, then `cd my-app`, `npm install`, and `npm run start`.

[docs/user/src/getting-started/004-installation.md](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/docs/user/src/getting-started/004-installation.md?L=50)

question: What does string!!Users mean?
answer:
`Effect.Effect<string, never, Users>`: a string result, no expected failures, and the Users service as a requirement. VibeLang infers all three.

[docs/user/src/001-onboarding.md](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/docs/user/src/001-onboarding.md?L=39)

question: What type does greeting return?
answer:
`greeting(name)` is `Effect.Effect<string, EmptyName, never>`. It throws EmptyName for an empty name. GreeterLive supplies the Greeter service used by main.

[templates/app/src/greeting.vibe](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/templates/app/src/greeting.vibe?L=3)

question: Why does catch not handle my defect?
answer:
Ordinary catch handles expected failures. Inspect defects at a defect or Cause boundary and preserve interruption. Explicit `throw new Error(...)` is a typed failure; `die(...)` creates a defect.

[docs/user/src/error-management/015-unexpected-errors.md](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/docs/user/src/error-management/015-unexpected-errors.md?L=17)

question: How do I check without emitting JavaScript?
answer:
Run `npx vibelang --noEmit`. It checks .vibe and .ts together; `--watch` rebuilds on save and `-b` builds project references.
